Va Tech Wabag Secures Effluent Treatment Plant Project from Reliance Industries

Va Tech Wabag has secured a repeat order from Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) for an effluent treatment plant. The project involves the design, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning of the plant. While specific financial details of the contract were not disclosed, the announcement led to a gain in Va Tech Wabag's stock price. This marks a continuation of the business relationship between the two companies.
